verdict.rationale: Rive's core model eliminates design-to-code handoff: the design file itself (.riv) is the production asset consumed directly by open-source runtimes across web, mobile, and game engines, explicitly marketed as 'No mockups, no prototypes, no handoff. The real thing' and 'What you build in the editor is what ships in your app, game, or website.' RML further lets developers construct/modify Rive files as text-based code for programmatic workflows, and GitHub runtime repos confirm real GPU-backed loading/rendering of these files in production apps. missing for 10: independent third-party case study of a production ship using Rive's design-to-code pipeline beyond vendor docs, and clearer component-to-code mapping analogous to Figma-to-React style tooling.
